message.jaymospowers.crucible.nothing_to: There is nothing in the pot to draw.
message.jaymospowers.crucible.full: The pot can hold no more.
message.jaymospowers.jar.other: The jar already holds something else.
research.jaymospowers.crucible.text: An iron-rimmed pot of copper, set over a fire and filled with water. Throw a thing in once the water boils and it comes apart into its essences; a little of every working is lost to the air as flux. A phial drawn through the liquid takes up the essence there is most of.
research.jaymospowers.orichalc.text: A rose-gold metal that is no ore at all. Iron thrown into a pot rich in Metal and Arcana is changed to it. It takes a spell better than any metal of the earth.
research.jaymospowers.principles.text: Salt, Sulphur and Mercury, made into things you can hold. Iron dust and the restless principle give a drop of quicksilver; powder and the burning one give brimstone; sugar and the holding one give an alchemical salt.
research.jaymospowers.alembic.text: A still of copper and glass that stands upon the pot. While the pot boils it draws off the essence there is most of, one drop at a time, into a jar set beside it. The jar keeps it, and keeps it still when carried.
research.jaymospowers.transmutation.text: Change one thing into another that is near it in worth. Iron into gold, if you can pay for it in wealth; copper into iron; and a handful of seed into two, if the pot is rich in what grows.
research.jaymospowers.everflame.text: A small flame that floats where you set it, gives full light and does not burn out. Glowstone dust thrown into a pot of Light and Fire is the whole of the secret.
